pages.title: Method
pages.text: Making a flower drink takes three steps.$(br2)$(li)Pick the flowers.$(li)Follow that flower's recipe and arrange the flowers and the extra ingredients in the crafting grid to make a tea bag.$(li)Put the tea bag in the teapot, pour in water or milk, and brew for 240 seconds.$(br2)Every flower has its own recipe, so check the Recipe page of the entry you want. One pot yields 12 cups.

pages.title: Layout
pages.text: This book is arranged as follows.$(br2)$(li)Every flower drink is sorted into one of six groups by the effect it leaves behind; browse them under Flower Drinks.$(li)Each entry gives the finished drink, its effect, its recipe and how to drink it.$(li)Recipes are always drawn as real crafting tables.$(li)Each entry closes with a maxim.
